newsitem.title: JAPAN: INSIGHT - JGBs may retest all-time high of 123.45.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - JGBs may retest all-time high of 123.45.

text.p: Key December Japanese government bond futures could make another try on Friday for 123.45, the all-time high for any JGB futures contract, after the contract closed in on that level in London on Thursday.
The market here was closed on Thursday for a national holiday and the December contract ended the London session at 123.43 on Thursday.
"If the December goes above 123.45, today's market might become another bullish day," said a dealer at a city bank's securities affiliate. Many dealers said market sentiment remained strong.
But because investors have recently been determined not to buy cash bonds, as they have become so expensive after the latest rally, the upside of the market should be limited, the dealers also said.
The recent uptrend was mainly performed by dealers, and investors were not following the trend, dealers said. "If only dealers are buying, they have to take profits quickly," said the dealer.
The market is also paying attention to the Bank of Japan governor Yasuo Matsushita's speech scheduled for 12.40 p.m. (0340 GMT).
